standard_prerequisites.name: Functoriality of the lisse-etale morphism of topoi
Descent of quasi-coherence along coverings
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the globally presented case.

standard_prerequisites.name: Structure sheaf of the lisse-etale site

core_obligations: Choose a surjective smooth x: U -> X; by the site-local definition pick a covering U_i such that f_i^{-1}H has a global presentation; the functorial lemma gives f_i^{-1}g_!H = g_{i,!}(f'_i)^{-1}H; the covering descent lemma for qc reduces to the globally presented case (proof lines 3534-3550).

g_! commutes with arbitrary colimits (left adjoint via the modules lemma and the categories lemma), so the presenting exact sequence of free modules pushes to an exact sequence with g_!O; the structure-sheaf lemma gives g_!O = O_X; part (2) is done, part (1) concludes with characterize-bis (proof lines 3550-3573).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a globally presented module via the covering descent lemma.
Push the presentation through the colimit-continuous g_!.
difficulty_reason: Reduction to a global presentation: the site-local definition gives an etale (fppf) covering on which the pullback has a global presentation, the functorial lemma transports g_! through the coverings, the descent lemma for qc reduces the claim to the globally presented case, and g_! (a left adjoint, hence colimit-continuous) preserves the presenting free exact sequence, with g_!O = O_X from the structure-sheaf lemma.
